problem_statement: When a 6LN IPv6 network interface receives a router advertisement containing a prefix information option with the on-link flag set, the option must be ignored and must not cause an IPv6 address to be added or updated. Currently such a PIO is treated as valid on a 6LN interface, so the prefix can be accepted as an address. The expected behaviour is that a 6LN interface ignores any PIO whose on-link flag is set.
